meta.name: performing-jwt-none-algorithm-attack
meta.description: Execute and test the JWT none algorithm attack to bypass signature verification by manipulating the alg header field in JSON Web Tokens.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要验证JWT实现是否存在alg头部篡改漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Bypass JWT signature verification to test security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify if JWT implementations are vulnerable to alg header tampering.

howto.what: Claude 会帮助你生成和测试 JWT none 算法攻击的令牌，尝试绕过签名验证。你会获得多种 alg 变体和签名格式的测试结果。
howto.when: 当你要求测试或执行 JWT none 算法攻击时触发。

say.text: 测试这个 JWT 的 none 算法变体。

say.text: 检查这个 JWT 是否有 none 算法漏洞。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you craft and test JWT none algorithm attack tokens to bypass signature verification. You get results for multiple alg variants and signature formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test or perform a JWT none algorithm attack.

say_en.note: Claude creates forged token and guides testing.
